prompt:
The same Berlin bicycle lane, seen from the side, wide, vertical frame. Two
men face each other on the red strip. On the left the young man in the navy
blue polo shirt, beige chinos and white leather sneakers stands still, turned
to his right toward the other man. On the right a man in his forties in a
BRIGHT YELLOW waterproof jacket has stopped his dark grey bicycle across the
lane and stands over it with one foot flat on the ground, facing him, one
hand on the handlebars. There is a pace of empty red strip between them. The
pale cream facade with its tall stone-framed windows and the black parked
bicycles run along behind. The lane is clear in both directions. Grey
pavement slabs to the left, a granite kerb. Daylight, overcast and flat.
